summary: Guards a single delegation: calls VehicleStateQueryAtLargeOffset(this) and returns 0 immediately when it is nonzero; otherwise loads the delegate pointer from the object chain *(this) + offset 0x1B79C (112540 decimal) and returns the result of calling SingleDelegationCall on it. operations.description: Call VehicleStateQueryAtLargeOffset(this) to obtain the guard predicate.
When the query result is nonzero, return 0 immediately and skip the delegation.
Dereference this+0x0 to get the object pointer, then load the delegate pointer from object offset 0x1B79C (112540 decimal).
Call SingleDelegationCall with the loaded delegate pointer and return its result.
Return the delegation result, or 0 when the query guard fired.
